description: All declining quality dimensions across the design, worst first — every node whose latest recorded observation on some `-ility` is worse than the one before, ranked by how far it fell. An empty list says which empty: nothing recorded, none declined, or every decline already dispositioned. Pass `target_id` and `dimension` to read ONE node on one axis, or either alone to narrow the sweep. Ask for this when you want to know what in the design is getting worse. Ask for this to see which quality measures are sliding across the whole design.

target_id.description:
Read only this node — with `dimension`, its observations on that axis
over time and whether the latest is worse (a null says which null).
